purpose: Connect an intended goal to the action taken to achieve it.
keywords: express wishes wants obligation permission request advice
V dictionary + べく; する → するべく / すべく
I headed to the site to establish the truth.
We revised the system to reduce the burden.
We established a fund to contribute to the community.
formation: V dictionary + べく; する → するべく / すべく
restrictions: Typically the same agent pursues the goal and performs the action.
mistake: Use for intention, not an accidental cause.
